resources.string: Lumen helper adds three things to the Lumen home screen: a small snapshot of the app you leave when you press Home (Android 11 or newer), Recents when you press Home twice, and returning to Lumen if the TV\'s own home screen appears. It watches remote button presses only to notice Home. It does not read text or controls in other apps, snapshots stay on this TV, and Lumen has no internet access.
